title: A great way to...
text: A great way to explore a neighborhood in a fun way. Instantly motivated kids and I am thrilled to see the iconic places and learn more about the place and culture! In short, don't hesitate!
author: MarieAmelie_L

title: I discovered a part of...
text: I discovered a part of Barcelona that I did not know so well and this is something I sharish and want to tell everyon about it. What a lovely discovery.
author: Patricia_F

title: A Refreshing Way to Explore!
text: The Explorial app truly enriched our exploration of Barcelona's Gothic Quarter. The app was intuitive and the tasks were thought-provoking, making the experience rewarding. It brought us to unseen corners and disclosed the stories behind them, allowing us to appreciate the city’s heritage in a new light. Whether you are a local or a tourist, this app will make you fall in love with Barcelona all over again! Highly recommend it!
author: Woese

title: 5 stars!
text: We had an awesome time on this tour! Barcelona is seriously amazing, and there are so many cool things about the city that we didn't know before. We had so much fun learning and exploring this beautiful city with this app. The information provided, and the quizzes were superb. We can't wait to do a tour like this again on our next trip!
author: Maya_E

title: Fun and cultural discovery
text:

author: abmoi

title: Ramblas and more
text: Barcelona is by far one of the most fascinating cities in Europe. Lots of movida and energy. Great app and tour to do at your own pace. We stopped for tapas :)
author: craigscholey

title: We really liked the tour and the app
text: The app is super fun with questions and puzzles that make us think and learn a lot about Barcelona. We really liked the app and the kids loved to play with the cell phone and learn about the city

title: Cool app and beautiful quarter!
text: Cool app and beautiful quarter! Would recommend to a group of friends and for families! I will play it again!

title: Found new places
text: We have been to the city many times already but there is always something new to discover in this beautiful city. We did this tour and found new spots that we didnt know before such as the Mercado de la Boqueria. The tour showed us the highlights of the gothic quarter. We would do it again.
author: Sydney_V

title: Fun way to discover Barcelona
text: That's not the first I played an Explorial trail, and I have to say, I just don't get bored by it. Can't wait to play more in new cities.
